name: Scandinavian minor kingdoms
summary: The period during the Middle Ages when Norsemen known as Vikings undertook large-scale raiding, colonising, conquest, and trading throughout Europe and reached North America.
legacy: They also briefly settled in Newfoundland, becoming the first Europeans to reach North America.

not_applicable.capital: many small kingdoms with separate seats; there is no single capital
not_applicable.before: the earliest Scandinavian kingdoms of the Viking Age, without a single earlier state
not_applicable.after: the small kingdoms merged into three successors (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), not one
